abyssal_apparition: Consume a [Charges|Power Charge] when you cast a damaging [Spell] to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same [Spell] for you. Does not work with [Channelling] Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, [Trigger|Triggered] Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a [Charges|Power Charge]. This Skill is not directly Supportable.
當你施放傷害型[Spell|法術]，會消耗一個[Charges|暴擊球]來觸發深淵幻象，它會和你施放同一個[Spell|法術]。無法使用[Channelling|引導]法術、具有冷卻時間的法術、[Trigger|觸發]法術、物品賦予的法術，或是已消耗[Charges|暴擊球]的法術。此技能無法直接提供輔助。
abyssal_living_bomb: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing [Physical] damage in an area.
在敵人的心臟種下一顆深淵能量種子。對敵人造成足夠傷害或擊殺時會引爆其心臟，在範圍內造成[Physical|物理]傷害。
abyssal_pact: Sacrifice some of a damageable [Minion|Minion's] life to deal [Physical] damage in an area around it.
獻祭可受傷的[Minion|召喚物的]部分生命，對其周圍造成範圍[Physical|物理]傷害。
acidic_concoction: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area. The thrown flask [Consume|Consumes] [Poison] on [Hit] to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
消耗魔力[Flask|藥劑]的充能，投出一個爆炸瓶，對一片區域造成[Physical|物理][Attack|攻擊]傷害，投出的爆炸瓶會在[Hit|擊中]時[Consume|消耗][Poison|毒]來引起酸性爆發。此傷害並不基於你的空手傷害，所以不視為[UnarmedAttack|空手攻擊]。
alchemists_boon: While active, grants you [Flask] charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your [Flask|Flasks] to also apply to [Allies] in your [Presence].
啟動時，被動給予你[Flask|藥劑]使用次數，並使你[Flask|藥劑]的生命和魔力恢復也會套用在你[Presence|存在範圍]內的[Allies|友方]身上。
align_fate: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your [Spell|Spells] from your first valid [WeaponSets|Weapon Set]. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same [Spell] aligns your fate, [Empowered|Empowering] that [Spell]. Visages can only cast damaging, non-[Channelling], non-[Buff] [Spell|Spells] you could cast that have no cooldown.

啟動時會間歇性的創造自身行動的有益平行時間線。這些時間線中的你會使用你第一組可用的[WeaponSets|武器組合]所能使用的一種[Spell|法術]。在下一道時間線幻影出現前，施放和該時間線的你所用的相同[Spell|法術]會使命運同調，並[Empowered|強化]該[Spell|法術]。幻影僅能施放傷害性、非[Channelling|引導]、非[Buff|增益]且你可以施放的無冷卻時間[Spell|法術]。
ancestral_cry: Perform a [Warcry] using [Glory] gained by [Ignite|Igniting] enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you [Trigger] Volcanic Steps while travelling, [Melee] [Strike|Strikes] and [Slam|Slams] are [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted], and your [Melee] [Strike|Strikes] [Trigger] Volcanic Eruption.
運用[Ignite|點燃]敵人所獲得的[Glory|榮耀]發出一聲[Warcry|戰吼]，讓你成為岡姆的化身。在岡姆的化身作用期間，你踏過的地方會[Trigger|觸發]熔火步伐，[Melee|近戰][Strike|打擊]和[Slam|重擊]會受到[AncestralBoost|先祖強化]，且你的[Melee|近戰][Strike|打擊]會[Trigger|觸發]火山迸發。
ancestral_spirits: This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] each time you summon a [Totem|Totem], summoning an Ancestral Spirit [Minion] to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.
此技能會於你召喚[Totem|圖騰]時[Triggered|觸發]，召喚一個先祖之靈[Minion|召喚物]為你作戰。若召喚出召喚物的圖騰死亡，由其觸發的先祖之靈也會死亡。
ancestral_warrior_totem: Consume 3 [Charges|Endurance Charges] to Raise a [Totem|Totem] that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed [Mace] Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use [Channelling] Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
消耗 3 個[Charges|耐力球]呼喚一個蘊含靈魂戰士的[Totem|圖騰]。每一名戰士都會在使用插槽中的[Mace|錘]技能一次後消失。無法使用[Channelling|引導]技能或有冷卻時間的技能。
ancient_gifts: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].
你已被阿茲莫里魂靈選中，提供你引導並指引你看見周遭的[AncientBlooms|遠古之綻]。
animus_exchange: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].
[Sacrifice|獻祭]你一部分的生命以回復[Ward|符文保護]。以此技能回復的[Ward|符文保護]可以[Overflow|溢出]。
animus_splinters: Expend a large amount of [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled], [Remote], Cooldown or [Conditional] Skills, or summon [Minion|Minions].
消耗大量[Ward|符文保護]，立即創造一個短暫的自身副本，使其使用一次插槽技能後消失。此技能的費用等同於插槽技能的總費用。副本無法施展[Channelling|引導]、[Remote|遠端]、冷卻或[Conditional|條件]技能，也無法召喚[Minion|召喚物]。
apocalypse: Build [Glory] by [Hit|Hitting] enemies with [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage. When you have maximum [Glory], you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, [Trigger|Triggering] one of multiple powerful [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Skills at an interval while this [Buff] lasts.
透過以[ElementalDamage|元素]傷害 [Hit|擊中] 敵人來累積[Glory|榮耀]。當你擁有最大[Glory|榮耀]時，你能在持續時間內成為行走災厄，在[Buff|增益效果]持續時間內週期性的[Trigger|觸發]多個強力[ElementalDamage|元素]技能中的一種。
archmage: While active, causes your Non-[Channelling] [Spell|Spells] to cost additional mana and deal extra [Lightning] damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
啟動時，使你的非[Channelling|引導][Spell|法術]消耗額外的魔力，並造成額外的[Lightning|閃電]傷害，兩者皆根據你的最大魔力而定。
archon_of_chayula: Build [Glory] by dealing [Chaos] damage to enemies. When you have maximum [Glory], you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his [Archon].
透過對敵人造成[Chaos|混沌]傷害來累積[Glory|榮耀]。當你擁有最大[Glory|榮耀]時，你可以懇求幻夢者寄宿於你體內，短暫成為他的[Archon|統治者]。
arctic_howl: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and [Freeze|Freezes] [PrimedFreeze|Primed] enemies. If an enemy is [Frozen] or a [Frozen] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] your attacks with added [Cold] damage, causes [Empowered] [Slam|Slams] to create [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground], and grants your [Allies] added [Cold] damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

[Shapeshift|變形]成 [Werewolf|狼人型態]並以寒冷的姿態猛嚎，傷害並[Frozen|冰凍][PrimedFreeze|可冰凍]的敵人。如果至少有一名敵人被[Frozen|冰凍]或 [Hit|擊中]，此技能會以[Cold|冰冷]傷害[Empowered|強化]你的攻擊，造成會創造[ChilledGround|冰緩地面]的[Empowered|強化][Slam|重擊]，並使你的[Allies|友方]獲得額外[Cold|冰冷]傷害。此技能的冷卻時間可以透過消耗一顆[Charges|耐力球]以重置。
armour_breaker: [Strike] with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their [Armour|Armour].
對目標進行一次強而有力的[Strike|打擊]，擊退敵人並削弱他們的[Armour|護甲]。
armour_piercing_rounds_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and [ArmourBreak|Break enemy Armour]. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
使用穿甲彈藥[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]。 其可以迅速射出多發能[ArmourBreak|破壞敵人護甲]的弩箭。再次使用此技能以重新裝填彈夾。
artillery_ballista: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that rains down a salvo of [Pinned|Pinning], [Maim|Maiming] bolts.
佈署一個[Ballista|砲塔] [Totem|圖騰]，該圖騰會降下一輪會造成 [Pinned|釘身]和 [Maim|癱瘓]的齊射弩箭。
attrition: While active, causes you to deal more [Hit] damage to [Rarity|Rare] and [Rarity|Unique] enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain [CullingStrike|Culling Strike] against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
啟動時，你與[Rarity|稀有]和[Rarity|傳奇]敵人交戰的時間越久，對其造成的[Hit|擊中]傷害越高，且與其交戰足夠久之後，獲得[CullingStrike|撲殺]效果。
atziri_herald: Killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon Damage], but is based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic].
以[BloodLoss|失血]擊殺一名敵人時會使其血腥的爆炸，對周遭敵人造成[Physical|物理][Attack|攻擊]傷害。此攻擊不基於你的[MartialWeapon|武器]傷害，而是基於目標累積的[BloodLoss|失血]。爆炸會視同敵人為[Rarity|普通或魔法]般摧毀其[Corpse|屍體]。
azmerian_swarm: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] or hit [Rarity|Rare or Unique] enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments]. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that pursue nearby enemies to [Attack] them and inflict [FaerieFire|Faerie Fire] on [Hit].
啟動時，在擊殺受[ElementalAilments|元素異常狀態]影響的敵人、或擊中受[ElementalAilments|元素異常狀態]影響的稀有和傳奇敵人時，會召喚短暫存活的阿茲莫里群落。這些群集為無法被指定的[Minion|召喚物]，且會追捕並[Attack|攻擊]周遭的敵人，在[Hit|擊中]時施加[FaerieFire|仙靈之火]。
ball_lightning: Fire a slow-moving [Projectile] that moves through enemies. The [Projectile] itself does not [Hit] enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of [Lightning] at nearby enemies. Consumes a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to slow down over time, create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] as it travels, and explode dealing [Fire] damage in an Area after it dissipates.
發射一個緩慢移動、可穿越敵人的[Projectile|投射物]。該[Projectile|投射物]本身無法[Hit|擊中]敵人，但會不斷對附近敵人釋放[Lightning|閃電]。情況許可時，會消耗[Fire|火焰][ElementalInfusion|灌注]來造成持續緩速，在行進過程中產生[IgnitedGround|點燃地面]，並在消散後爆炸，對一個區域造成[Fire|火焰]傷害。
barkskin: While active, taking [Hit] damage from enemies to your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] causes you to gain [Armour] for a short duration. [Armour] gained from multiple [Hit|Hits] can stack. The total [Armour] gained from this Skill cannot exceed the [ItemArmour|Item Armour] on your [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items].
啟動時，以[EnergyShield|能量護盾]承受來自敵人的[Hit|擊中]傷害時會使你短暫獲得[Armour|護甲]。從複數[Hit|擊中]獲得的[Armour|護甲]可以堆疊。從此技能獲得的總[Armour|護甲]無法超過[EquipArmour|裝備護甲]的[ItemDefences|物品護甲值]。
barrier_invocation: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is damaged by Enemy [Hit|Hits]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
啟動時，當你的[EnergyShield|能量護盾]承受到敵人的[Hit|擊中]傷害，便會獲得[Energy|能量]。收集到足夠的[Energy|能量]後使用祈願，將會消耗[Energy|能量]以觸發插槽中的[Spell|法術]，若有足夠的[Energy|能量]則可以觸發多次。
bear_fury_of_the_mountain: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and repeatedly pound the ground, creating [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
[Shapeshift|變形]成[Bear|巨熊型態]並猛擊地面數次，創造會在你面前以弧形大幅隨機穿梭的[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂縫]。
bear_maul: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and rake enemies with your claws, generating [Rage] on [Hit].
[Shapeshift|變形]成[Bear|巨熊型態]並以尖爪揮掃攻擊敵人，並在[Hit|擊中]時會產生[Rage|盛怒]。
bear_rampage: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and charge forward, [Slam|Slamming] the ground as you run. [Channelling] ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending [Rage].
變形成[Bear|巨熊型態]並向前猛襲，在奔跑過程中[Slam|重擊]地面。[Channelling|引導]會在短暫時間後結束，但可以透過消耗[Rage|盛怒]延長。
berserk: While active, strengthens your [Rage], but causes you to lose Life while not losing [Rage].
啟動時，加強你的[Rage|盛怒]，但會使你失去生命而不會失去[Rage|盛怒]。
bind_spectre: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a [Reviving] [Minion|Minion].
捕捉遭擊敗怪物的靈魂，將這顆寶石轉變為允許你將怪物的鬼魂召喚為[Reviving|復甦][Minion|召喚物]。
bitter_dead: Spend [Ward] and target an area, transforming [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.
消耗[Ward|符文保護]並以一片區域為目標，將[Corpse|屍體]轉化為會追蹤並[Chill|冰緩]周遭敵人的苦澀核心。核心會在持續時間結束時爆炸，創造會造成額外[Cold|冰冷]持續傷害的符文。
black_powder_blitz_reservation: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that [Blind|Blinds] and [Ignite|Ignites] enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.
將閃避翻滾替換為爆炸輔助的跳躍，從義腿的火砲射出一發砲彈，對你所逃離區域內的敵人施加[Blind|致盲]和[Ignite|點燃]。該爆炸也會使效果範圍內的任何[Grenade|擲彈]一起爆炸。
blasphemy: Turn socketed [Curse] skills into vile [Aura|Auras], applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
將所有插槽中的[Curse|詛咒]技能轉變為惡毒[Aura|光環]，將效果套用於周圍所有敵人。
bleeding_concoction: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area and [Aggravate|Aggravating Bleeding] on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
消耗魔力[Flask|藥劑]的充能，投出一個爆炸瓶，對一片區域造成[Physical|物理][Attack|攻擊]傷害，並使受擊中敵人的[Aggravate|流血加劇]。此傷害並不基於你的空手傷害，所以不視為[UnarmedAttack|空手攻擊]。
blink: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
啟動時，以一個冷卻時間極短的[Spell|法術]取代你的閃避翻滾，讓你可穿越空間，立即現身於中距離外的一處。
blink_reservation: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
啟動時，以一個冷卻時間極短的[Spell|法術]取代你的閃避翻滾，讓你可穿越空間，立即現身於中距離外的一處。
blood_boil: Enemies in your [Presence] accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] to enemies near them.
在你[Presence|存在範圍]中的敵人會週期性地累積鮮血沸騰。當它們死亡後，沸騰的鮮血便會引爆，並對其附近的敵人施加[CorruptedBlood|腐化之血]。
blood_hunt: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a blood explosion and also [Consume] [Bleeding]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
朝一個目標突進，並施展穿刺。擊中一名承受[BloodLoss|失血]的敵人會引發血爆，也會將[Bleeding|流血][Consume|消耗]。這個技能無法受到[AncestralBoost|先祖強化]。
bloodhounds_mark: [Mark] a target, making them suffer [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] build up from [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark] will [MarkActivate|Activate], [Consume|Consuming] itself to [Trigger] Blood Explosion, when they are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned], or when they are killed if they suffered enough [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark]'s duration does not expire while the [Mark|Marked] target is suffering [BloodLoss|Blood Loss].

對一個目標施加[Mark|印記]，使他們[BloodLoss|失血]，並累積[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]。若目標在有[Mark|印記]時被[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]、或是承受足量[BloodLoss|失血]並遭到擊殺時印記會[MarkActivate|啟動]，[Consume|消耗]自身以釋放一次鮮血爆炸。帶有[Mark|印記]的目標承受[BloodLoss|失血]時，[Mark|印記]持續時間不會倒數。
bombadier_destructive_link: Detonate an allied [Minion] whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy [Attack] damage to nearby enemies.
引爆目前生命低於一定限值的友方[Minion|召喚物]，對附近敵人造成高額[Attack|攻擊]傷害。
bone_blast: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing [Bleeding].
施展持續一小段時間的祭祀銘文圈。持續時間結束時，會使範圍內的所有敵人身上冒出骨刺，對其造成傷害，且有可能造成[Bleeding|流血]。
bone_cage: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and [Pinned|Pinning] those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
在你的周圍召出一圈骨刺。敵人接觸骨刺時會將其摧毀，承受傷害並被[Pinned|釘身]。召出一圈新的骨刺會摧毀前一圈。
bone_offering: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your [Minion|Minions] while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from [Hit|Hits]. Taking a [Hit] that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that [Minion|Minion's] shield to absorb all damage from that [Hit], then explode.  The bone spike is itself a [Minion], and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other [Minion|Minions] disappear.

啟動時，以非[Herald|捷光環][Attack|攻擊][Hit|擊中]並擊殺[Shock|感電]敵人會使後續的[Attack|攻擊][Hit|擊中]釋放雷擊，對周圍所有敵人造成[Attack|攻擊]傷害。
hexblast: Detonate a [Curse] on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of [Chaos] damage but removing the [Curse]. Can only detonate [Curse|Curses] for which at least half of the duration has expired.
引爆區域內所有敵人身上的一個[Curse|詛咒]，造成帶有[Chaos|混沌]傷害的爆炸，但同時移除該[Curse|詛咒]。只能引爆持續時間至少剩下一半的[Curse|詛咒]。
high_velocity_rounds_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that apply [RivenArmour|Riven Armour] to enemies with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour], causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.
以[Pierce|穿透]弩箭[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]，其會對[ArmourBreak|完全破甲]的敵人施加[RivenArmour|碎甲]，使任何對該敵人的[Hit|擊中]造成額外傷害。
his_foul_emergence: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving [WitheringGround|Withering Ground] in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
召喚一顆從無光深淵升起的恐怖頭骨啃咬敵人，對目標位置造成大量傷害並在該位置產生[WitheringGround|凋零地面]。若指定近距離的目標，則施放時會使你向後跳躍。
his_winnowing_flame: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Fire] damage to enemies and [Consume|Consuming] [Ignite] to create pillars of flame. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].
召喚一把深淵鐮刀橫掃指定區域，對敵人造成[Fire|火焰]傷害並[Consume|消耗][Ignite|點燃]以產生火柱。無法受[Trigger|觸發]。
hollow_focus: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your [Hit|Hits] immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. The bells are themselves always [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun], they can be [CullingStrike|Culled], and [Hit|Hits] against them are always [Critical|Critical Hits].
啟動時，幻影之鐘會週期性的在你周遭出現。你的[Hit|擊中]會立即摧毀鐘，創造一道會對周遭敵人造成傷害並[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩][PrimedStun|可暈眩]敵人的震波。這些鐘本身總是[PrimedStun|可暈眩]，且可以被[CullingStrike|撲殺]，且以其為目標的[Hit|擊中]總是[Critical|暴擊]。
hollow_form: [Channelling|Channel] to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed [Melee] [Attack] once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled] Skills or [Conditional] Skills. Consuming a [Charges|Power Charge] creates additional images.
[Channelling|引導]以在目標位置創造短暫持續的奔竄靈體分身。此分身會施展一次插槽中的[Melee|近戰][Attack|攻擊]並於隨後消失，若允許則會以最近的敵人為目標。分身無法施展[Channelling|引導]或[Conditional|條件]技能。可以消耗[Charges|暴擊球]以創造額外分身。
hollow_resonance: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. [Critical|Critical Hits] with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.
將一座幻影之鐘扛到你的背上。以其他技能[Critical|暴擊擊中]時會使鐘聲迴盪，對周遭敵人造成傷害。
hollow_shell: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby [Allies] [Guard].
犧牲你的[Ward|符文保護]以釋放一道能量波動，賦予周遭[Allies|友方][Guard|守護]。
hydra: While active, a companion Hydra will rear up from your body and regularly cast socketed [Projectile] [Spell|Spells] at nearby [Shock|Shocked], [Frozen], and [Ignite|Ignited] enemies.
啟動期間，一隻九頭蛇盟友會附著於你的身體，每隔一段時間向周圍[Shock|感電]、[Frozen|冰凍]及[Ignite|點燃]的敵人施放插槽中的[Projectile|投射物][Spell|法術]。
hyena_cackle: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena [Companion|Companions]. The cackle is treated as a single [Companion] for effects that count or limit [Companion|Companions], regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, [Hinder|Hindering] nearby enemies, and have a chance to [Maim] enemies they [Hit].
啟動以召喚一群奸笑的鬣狗[Companion|盟友]。鬣狗群在計算[Companion|盟友]上限時會被視為單一的[Companion|盟友]，無論該群中的鬣狗數量。鬣狗們在初次現身時會叫喊，[Hinder|阻礙]周遭的敵人，且有機率[Maim|癱瘓]牠們[Hit|擊中]的敵人。
hypothermia: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Cold] [Resistances|Resistance].
在短暫延遲後，對一片區域內的所有目標降下[Curse|詛咒]，降低其[Cold|冰冷][Resistances|抗性]。
ice_nova: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt [Projectile] will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to leave a patch of [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].
朝所有方向施展一道寒冰之潮，根據敵人與你的距離造成[Knockback|擊退]。如果在寒冰彈[Projectile|投射物]附近施放冰霜新星，則會改為從寒冰彈釋放，而非你身上。情況許可時，會[Consume|消耗]一道[Cold|冰冷][ElementalInfusion|灌注]，產生一塊[ChilledGround|冰緩地面]。
ice_shards_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
使用寒冰碎片[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]。 其會迅速向地面射出冰冷的弩箭，在擊中處留下一段時間後會武裝的寒冰碎片。在碎片武裝後，當敵人踩到寒冰碎片時會使其爆炸，武裝時間越長則造成更多傷害，直到達最大值。再次使用此技能以重新裝填彈夾。
ice_shot: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
射出一支冰箭，在擊中一個目標時朝扇形範圍內噴出碎冰。
ice_strike: Perform a fast icy [Strike]. Using this [Attack|Attack] three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
施展一次快速的寒冰[Strike|打擊]。短時間內使用此 [Attack|攻擊]三次時，最後一下攻擊的施展速度較慢但傷害較高。
ice_tipped_arrows: Ready your active [Bow] or [Spear], [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear] [Attack|Attacks] to [Conversion|Convert] [Physical] Damage to [Cold] Damage and [Trigger] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on [Hit]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] [Sustained] Skills.

準備你目前使用中的[Bow|弓]或[Spear|長矛]，[Empowered|強化]你下一次[Repeat|可重複]的[Bow|弓][Attack|攻擊]或[Projectile|投射物][Spear|長矛][Attack|攻擊]，使其將[Physical|物理]傷害[Conversion|轉換]為[Cold|冰冷]傷害，並在[Hit|擊中]時[Trigger|觸發][IceFragment|寒冰碎片]。此技能的冷卻時間可藉由消耗 1 個[Charges|狂怒球]無視。無法[Empowered|強化][Sustained|持續性]技能。
icestorm: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. [Chill] and [Freeze] on enemies in front of you are [Consume|Consumed] to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
呼喚無數寒冰彈如冰雹一般灑落在目標區域。前方敵人身上的[Chill|冰緩]和[Freeze|冰凍]會被[Consume|消耗]，透過製造強化冰彈為冰風暴提供燃料。
impurity: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Chaos Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
施放一個[Aura|光環]，使你和你[Presence|存在範圍]內的[Allies|友方]獲得[Resistances|混沌抗性]。
incendiary_shot_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and [Ignite|Igniting] enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].
使用烈焰射擊[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]。其會在飛行時分裂，對被擊中的敵人及最終目標後方小型扇形區域造成傷害並[Ignite|點燃]。這些碎片可[Merging|融合]。
incinerate_player: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of [Fire] from your hand, [Ignite|Igniting] enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you [Channelling|Channel]. [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to also create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
透過任何技能消耗魔力來獲得燃料，並使用累積的燃料施展一道[Fire|火焰]波浪，對你前方的敵人施加[Ignite|點燃]。你[Channelling|引導]的時間越長，火焰就越熾烈。情況許可時，會[Consume|消耗]一道[Fire|火焰][ElementalInfusion|灌注]來產生[IgnitedGround|點燃地面]。使用此技能時無法獲得燃料。
inevitable_agony: [Debuff] all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from [Hit|Hits] to be tracked by the [Debuff]. When the [Debuff|debuff's] duration expires or can kill the target, the target [LifeLoss|loses life] equal to that tracked damage all at once.
在短暫延遲後[Debuff|減益]一片區域內的所有目標，使其受到的一部分[Hit|擊中]傷害被[Debuff|減益]效果追蹤。當[Debuff|減益]效果的持續時間結束或目標會被其擊殺時，他們會[LifeLoss|失去]等同於追蹤傷害的生命。
infernal_cry: Perform a [Warcry], [Empowered|Empowering] subsequent [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
如果附近有敵人，使用[Warcry|戰吼]會[Empowered|強化]接下來的[Attack|攻擊]。戰吼範圍內的敵人會變得不穩定，並會在死亡時觸發戰燃。消耗[Charges|耐力球]可略過此技能的冷卻時間。
into_the_breach: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby [FlamesOfChayula|Flames of Chayula]. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
在你周圍製造一道裂痕，使你可以看見附近的[FlamesOfChayula|夏烏拉之炎]。此技能啟動時，你被視為處於裂痕中。
iron_ward: While active, stores a percentage of the [Physical] damage that is prevented by your [Armour] or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
啟動時，儲存一定比例你[Armour|護甲]或其他傷害減免來源所防止的[Physical|物理]傷害。使用此技能會以尖刺新星釋放儲存的傷害。
killing_palm: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [CullingStrike|Cullable] targets in range if your target was [CullingStrike|Culled]. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a [Charges|Power Charge], with higher [Rarity] monsters granting additional [Charges]. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.

衝向一名敵人並對其進行[Strike|打擊]，若敵人的生命夠低則將其[CullingStrike|撲殺]。如果你的目標被[CullingStrike|撲殺]，則額外衝刺並[Strike|打擊]至周遭範圍內[CullingStrike|可撲殺]的敵人。打擊每擊殺一名敵人即賦予一個[Charges|暴擊球]，[Rarity|稀有度]越高的怪物會賦予額外的[Charges|能量球]。你周圍的可[CullingStrike|撲殺]敵人會被重點標示。
leap_slam:
Jump into the air, damaging and [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

朝著目標區域躍起，並在落地時以你的武器重擊並[Knockback|擊退]範圍內的敵人。被踩到的敵人將會
被推出去。
leylines: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful [Spell] damage boost but constantly drains your [Ward|Runic Ward]. Running out of [Ward|Runic Ward] causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
啟動時，定期在你附近顯現強烈符文能量的區域。站在其上會給予你強大的[Spell|法術]傷害加成，但會持續消耗你的[Ward|符文保護]。[Ward|符文保護]耗盡時，能量將會消散。
life_remnants: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a target spawns a Life [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Life [Remnant] grants you Life which can [Overflow|Overflow] maximum Life.
飲下敵人的鮮血以恢復你的生命。啟動期間，你擊殺的敵人有機率生成生命[Remnant|痕跡]，並且每隔數秒[Hit|擊中]目標時會生成一個生命[Remnant|痕跡]。拾取生命[Remnant|痕跡]會賦予你生命值，且能[Overflow|溢出]至超過最大生命值。
lightning_arrow: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams at nearby enemies.
對目標射出一發充滿閃電能量的箭矢，擊中敵人或牆壁時，箭矢會向附近的敵人發射[Chain|連鎖]的[Lightning|閃電]光束。
lightning_bolt: Call down a [Shock|Shocking] bolt of [Lightning] to strike enemies in a small area.
呼喚一發[Shock|感電][Lightning|雷電]打擊小範圍內的敵人。
lightning_conduit: Call down [Lightning] to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to [Shock|Shocked] enemies. If there is a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
召喚[Lightning|閃電]擊中你面前扇形範圍內的所有敵人，對[Shock|感電]敵人造成顯著更多傷害。如果目標區域內有[Shock|感電]敵人，額外的雷彈會在擊中的目標間分配。目標位置離你較近時，施展此技能會使你朝後方跳躍。
lightning_rod: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning|Lightning] beams can [Chain|Chain] to it. When [Chain|Chained] to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
發射一支從上方落下的箭矢，引起[Lightning|閃電]爆發。箭矢會嵌入地面，任何[Chain|連鎖][Lightning|閃電]光束可與其[Chain|連鎖]。受到[Chain|連鎖]時，箭矢會先進行短暫充能，接著釋出另一次的[Lightning|閃電]爆發。閃電箭矢技能會降低這個延遲，使爆發來臨的更加迅速。
lightning_spear: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt [Projectile|Projectiles] at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
投出所持長矛的一個複製品。它會在擊中敵人時爆發，對大範圍內多個其他敵人射出第二發閃電箭[Projectile|投射物]。在可能的情況下會消耗一個[Charges|狂怒球]，使主要長矛在衝擊時分裂成多個複製品，隨後每個複製品都會爆炸。
lightning_warp: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [Debuff] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning [Projectile|Projectiles]. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals [Lightning|Lightning] damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground]. Creates a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be [CullingStrike|Culled].

如果一名敵人處於[CullingStrike|撲殺]門檻內，則傳送至目標體內，使其發生劇烈爆炸；反之則為其施加[Debuff|減益]，使其在減益持續時間內若生命降至[CullingStrike|撲殺]門檻時觸發同樣的效果。此技能也可以對天雷之珠的[Projectile|投射物]使用。傳送時目標會被摧毀，且爆炸會對周圍的敵人造成[Lightning|閃電]傷害。以敵人為目標時，該爆炸也會創造出[ShockedGround|感電地面]。成功使用時會產生一道[Lightning|閃電][ElementalInfusion|灌注]。會對[CullingStrike|撲殺]門檻內的敵人以醒目提示標註。
lingering_illusion: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a [Remnant] that grants you a [Charges|Power Charge] on pickup.
啟動時，每當你閃避翻滾，會創造出一個自己的幻影分身，持續一小段時間。該分身可由敵人造成傷害，並在遭敵人摧毀時給你一個[Charges|暴擊球]。
living_bomb_player: Plant a seed of [Fire] inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a [ElementalInfusion|Fire Infusion] [Remnant].
在敵人體內植入[Fire|火焰]種子。對敵人造成足夠傷害，或是直接擊殺時，會使得種子爆炸，對一定範圍造成傷害，並留下一道[ElementalInfusion|火焰灌注][Remnant|痕跡]。
lunar_assault: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
[Shapeshift|變形]成 [Werewolf|狼人型態]並揮舞雙爪，發射一枚新月型彈道的冰晶弦月投射物。
magma_barrier: While active, increases your [ChanceToBlock|Block Chance] passively and imbues your [Shield] with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next [Block|Block] with your [Shield] raised will expend the lava to [Trigger] the Magma Spray skill and grant you an [Charges|Endurance Charge].
啟動時被動增加你的[ChanceToBlock|格擋率]，並持續用岩漿灌注你的[Shield|盾牌]。當盾牌完全注能時，你下次舉起[Shield|盾牌]的[Block|格擋]會擴散岩漿並[Trigger|觸發]岩漿噴濺技能，且賦予你一顆[Charges|耐力球]。
magnetic_salvo: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other [Lightning] [Attack|Attacks] in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
瞄準天空並對你前方由你其他的[Lightning|閃電][Attack|攻擊]所產生的殘留弩箭或箭矢發射能量導彈。導彈落在殘留弩箭或箭矢附近時會爆炸，在更大的範圍內造成更多傷害，但在過程中會摧毀弩箭或箭矢。
malice: While active, emits an [Aura] that continuously inflicts [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness] on enemies in your [Presence].
啟動時，散發一道 [Aura|光環]，持續對你 [Presence|存在]存在範圍內的敵人造成[CriticalWeakness|暴擊弱點]。

profane_ritual: Mark a [Corpse] with a profane rune, dealing [Chaos] damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the [Corpse] is consumed and you gain a [Charges|Power Charge].
以粗陋符文標記一具[Corpse|屍體]，對周圍敵人造成[Chaos|混沌]持續傷害。祭祀結束後會消耗該[Corpse|屍體]，而你會獲得一個[Charges|暴擊球]。
projectile_arc: An arc of [Lightning|Lightning] stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and [Chain|Chains] on to other nearby enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to deal more damage and [Chain] further.
從施放者向目標敵人延伸出一道[Lightning|閃電]之弧，並對其他附近敵人[Chain|連鎖]。情況許可時，會[Consume|消耗][Lightning|閃電][ElementalInfusion|灌注]來造成更多傷害並進一步[Chain|連鎖]。
purity_of_fire: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Fire Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
施放一個[Aura|光環]，使你和你[Presence|存在範圍]內的[Allies|友方]獲得[Resistances|火焰抗性]。
purity_of_ice: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Cold Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
施放一個[Aura|光環]，使你和你[Presence|存在範圍]內的[Allies|友方]獲得[Resistances|冰冷抗性]。
purity_of_lightning: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Lightning Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].
施放一個[Aura|光環]，使你和你[Presence|存在範圍]內的[Allies|友方]獲得[Resistances|閃電抗性]。
queens_procession_reservation: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals [Physical] [Attack] damage, which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup if this [Hit|Hits] any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] or interrupt your sprinting.
啟動時，衝刺會使你成為一陣蝗蟲群，在你周遭的區域內造成不基於[MartialWeapon|武器]傷害的[Physical|物理][Attack|攻擊]傷害。若此[Hit|擊中]任何目標，你會承受傷害並累積[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]，但你衝刺期間不會受到來自其他來源的[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]累積或被中斷衝刺。
raging_spirits: While active, [Fire|Fire] [Spell|Spells] you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly [Attack|Attack] them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.
啟動期間，你自己施放的[Fire|火焰][Spell|法術]也會召喚憤怒狂靈，這種持續時間短暫的火焰骷髏會衝向附近的敵人並快速[Attack|攻擊]，但會無視號令。敵人不會直接與這些[Minion|召喚物]交戰，並可穿過他們。
rain_of_arrows_new: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. [Consume|Consumes] a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] to fire more arrows.
將一道箭雨射向空中，使其從天上落下。[Consume|消耗]你的[Charges|狂怒球]可增加射出的箭矢數量。
rain_of_blades: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjuring blades. For the duration of the [Buff], these blades fall on enemies [Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].
將你的[Ward|符文保護]傾瀉至凝聚的刀刃之中。在[Buff|增益效果]期間，這些刀刃會落於你的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻擊][Hit|擊中]的敵人。
raise_zombie: Consume a [Corpse|Corpse] or [Charges|Power Charge] to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from [Charges|Power Charges] are [Empowered] and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.
消耗一具[Corpse|屍體]或一顆[Charges|暴擊球]來創造一個短暫存在的殭屍。透過[Charges|暴擊球]創造的殭屍會被[Empowered|強化]，同時創造兩名未強化的殭屍。
rake: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting [Bleeding] on all enemies struck.
向前衝向一名敵人，並施展撕裂斬擊，對所有擊中的敵人施加[Bleeding|流血]。
rapid_assault: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts [Bleeding] and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, [Maim|Maiming] them for a duration. [Detonator] Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.
施展六次快速刺擊。最後一下刺擊會造成[Bleeding|流血]，並會把利鋒留在目標身上，[Maim|癱瘓]他們一段時間。[Detonator|引爆器]技能會使利鋒爆炸，對目標和附近的其他敵人進一步造成傷害。
rapid_shot_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a large clip of heated bolts. [Heat] builds up on your [Crossbow] as you fire them, and reaching maximum [Heat] will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume [Heat] for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
使用疾射[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]。在你發射時，[Heat|熱能]會在你的[Crossbow|十字弓]上累積，在達到最大熱能後會使你在短時間內無法發射箭矢。然而，其他技能可以消耗[Heat|熱能]來獲得額外效果。再次使用此技能以重新裝填彈夾。
ravenous_swarm: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that [Attack] and [Poison] enemies.
當啟動時存在敵人，會從你的體內出現蟲族追擊附近敵人。蟲群為無法做為目標的[Minion|召喚物]，會[Attack|攻擊]敵人並使其[Poison|中毒]。
reap: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Physical] damage to enemies and applying [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness]. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].
召喚一把血腥鐮刀橫掃指定區域，對敵人造成[Physical|物理]傷害並施加[CriticalWeakness|暴擊弱點]。無法受[Trigger|觸發]。
reapers_invocation: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you kill an enemy with a [Melee] [Attack]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
啟動時，當你以[Melee|近戰][Attack|攻擊]擊殺一名敵人，會獲得[Energy|能量]。收集到足夠的[Energy|能量]後使用祈願，將會消耗[Energy|能量]以觸發插槽中的[Spell|法術]，若有足夠的[Energy|能量]則可以觸發多次。
refutation: Spends all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to gain a short-duration [Buff] that causes you to [Block] all [Block|Blockable] [Hit|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies from which you've [Block|Blocked] a [Hit]. This [Buff] is removed if you are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned]. While this [Buff] is active, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.

消耗你所有的[Ward|符文保護]以獲得一個短暫的[Buff|增益效果]，使你[Block|格擋]所有[Block|可格擋]的[Hit|擊中]，並對你曾[Block|格擋][Hit|擊中]來源的敵人施加[ParriedDebuff|受招架]。若你被[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]，此[Buff|增益效果]將會解除。此[Buff|增益效果]生效期間，你不會[LightStun|被輕微暈眩]，但[Block|格擋]過多傷害可能使你[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]。
remnants_of_kalguur: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].
啟動時，你[Stun|暈眩]或擊殺的敵人有機率生成[Ward|符文保護][Remnant|痕跡]。這些[Remnant|痕跡]可以[Overflow|溢出]你的[Ward|符文保護]。
rend: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a [Charges|Power Charge] if possible to grant you a [Buff] that gives you extra [Lightning] damage. While you have the [Buff], Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
[Shapeshift|變形] 成 [Wyvern|飛龍型態] 並以翼爪施展一次寬廣的斬擊。如果可以，則會消耗一顆[Charges|暴擊球]並給予自身一個會造成額外[Lightning|閃電]傷害的[Buff|增益]。在你有該[Buff|增益]時，撕扯的範圍會更加擴大，但速度更慢。
repulsion: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to [Curse] enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. [Hit|Hitting] these enemies removes the [Curse] to [Trigger] an explosion, [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and causing more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility on the target [Hit].
消耗[Ward|符文保護]以鎖定一個區域並以維里西姆符文[Curse|詛咒]範圍內的敵人，對其施加易碎。[Hit|擊中]這些敵人會使[Curse|詛咒][Trigger|觸發]爆炸，在範圍內造成傷害，並對[Curse|受詛咒]目標附近的其他敵人施加強力[Knockback|擊退]，依據目標被[Hit|擊中]時的易碎程度累積更多[Stun|暈眩]。
requiem_ammo: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your [Crossbow] shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use [Ammunition].
你武器中罪魂會被動累積悲痛。充能完成時，使用此技能會譜成安魂曲，將你的[Crossbow|十字弓]射擊轉換為一道無盡悲痛，持續一小段固定時間。不會使用[Ammunition|彈藥]。
resonating_shield: Repeatedly hammer your [Shield|Shield] with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose [Armour|Armour] for a duration. While [Channelling] Resonating Shield, your [Shield|Shield] is raised and you will [Block|Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits.
以武器反覆錘打自己所持的[Shield|盾牌]，在自身周圍產生傷害性震波。遭震波擊中的敵人會在一段時間內損失[Armour|護甲]。[Channelling|引導]共鳴之盾時，你會舉起[Shield|盾牌]並[Block|格擋]所有來襲的[Block|可格擋]擊中。
righteous_descent: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a [DivineFragment|Fragment of Divinity] near you or the targeted location, this attack will [Consume] it when you leap to become [Empowered], dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
以神聖之翼躍然騰空，並以你的長矛對著地位置的敵人造成傷害。如果你周遭或目標位置附近有一枚 [DivineFragment|神性碎片]，此攻擊會[Consume|消耗]它並[Empowered|強化]你的躍擊，造成更多傷害並賦予生命和魔力回復。此技能在受到強化時不會消耗其冷卻。
ritual_sacrifice: Sacrifice the [Corpse] of a [Rarity|Rare] Monster to grant you its [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] for a duration, or gain a single random [MonsterModifiers|Modifier] at the cost of your own life force.
獻祭一個[Rarity|稀有]怪物的[Corpse|屍體]，賦予你持續一段時間的該怪物[MonsterModifiers|詞綴]，或是以自身生命能量作為代價以獲得一條隨機的[MonsterModifiers|詞綴]。
rolling_magma: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill[Chain|Chains], bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] or Volcanos will activate them as though they were [Slam|Slammed].
[Shapeshift|變形] 成 [Wyvern|飛龍型態] 並拋投出撞擊地面時會爆炸的岩漿球。此技能會[Chain|連鎖]，向前彈跳並造成多次傷害。若其撞擊到[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂縫] 或火山，則會視同[Slam|被重擊]一樣觸發它們。
rolling_slam: [Slam|Slam] the ground to [Stun|Stun] enemies and [Knockback|knock them away], then continue forward and perform a devastating second [Slam|Slam].
[Slam|重擊]地面，將敵人[Stun|擊暈]並[Knockback|擊退]，接著繼續前進，施展第二次的毀滅性[Slam|重擊]。
runic_reprieve: [Channelling|Channel] to create a protective bubble all around you, [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] against you. While [Channelling] this Skill, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by [Hit|Hits] you [Block], and damage you take from [Hit|Hits] is also removed from [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] this way causes you to accumulate [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot recover [Ward|Runic Ward] while this Skill is active.

[Channelling|引導]以在你四周創造一道防護氣泡，[Block|格擋]對你的[Hit|擊中]。[Channelling|引導]此技能時，你無法被你所[Block|格擋]的[Hit|擊中][LightStun|被輕微暈眩]，且你承受的[Hit|擊中]傷害會在影響生命前先從[Ward|符文保護]中扣除。以此方式[Block|格擋][Hit|擊中]會使你累積[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]。此技能啟動時，你無法恢復[Ward|符文保護]。
runic_tempering: [Channelling|Channel] to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are [Hit] while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your [Thorns] damage in an area around your attacker.
[Channelling|引導]以為你的護甲注入符文。當你擁有這些符文時被[Hit|擊中]，你所承受的一部分傷害將被避免，並對你的攻擊者造成反擊，對攻擊者的周遭範圍內造成[Thorns|荊棘]傷害。
sacrifice: While active, your undead [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] can be used in place of [Corpse|Corpses] by your skills, but your [Minion|Minions] [Reviving|Revive] more slowly.
啟動時，你的不死[Reviving|復甦][Minion|召喚物]可以用來替代你的技能所使用的[Corpse|屍體]，但你的[Minion|召喚物][Reviving|復甦]速度減慢。
sanguine_revelry: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, [Bleeding] enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a [Bleeding] target spawns a Hateful [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful [Remnant] grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.
喚起憎惡能量作為你盛怒和生命的燃料。啟動時，你擊殺的[Bleeding|流血]敵人有機率生成一個憎惡[Remnant|痕跡]，且[Hit|擊中]一名[Bleeding|流血]目標時會每幾秒生成一個憎惡[Remnant|痕跡]。拾起憎惡[Remnant|痕跡]會賦予你盛怒和根據你當前盛怒回復生命。
savage_fury: While active, your Fury builds from [Attack|Attacking] enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and [Onslaught] but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.
啟動時，你[Attack|攻擊]敵人時會累積怒氣。使用此技能時會釋放你的狂怒並使你進入野獸般的瘋狂狀態，獲得傷害和[Onslaught|猛攻] 但會持續失去生命且會強制你處於動物型態。狂怒狀態會在你回到人類型態時立即結束。你無法在狂怒狀態期間獲得怒氣。
scattering_calamity: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing [Lightning] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
召喚出在你上方盤旋並發出爆鳴的電湧之靈。在短時間後，電湧之靈飛向敵人，擊中時對一片範圍造成[Lightning|閃電]傷害，並優先挑選最後一個作為目標的敵人為目標。重新施放此法術會重置所有現有電湧之靈的持續時間。
scavenged_plating: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. [ArmourBreak|Fully Breaking] an enemy's [Armour] grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's [Rarity], and you gain [Armour] and [Thorns] per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.
啟動時，使用自敵人收集而來的護甲碎片加強自己的護甲。[ArmourBreak|完全破壞]敵人的[Armour|護甲]時，會依據其[Rarity|稀有度]賦予你數層的拾荒者護板，持續一段時間，每層使你獲得[Armour|護甲值]和[Thorns|荊棘]。普通敵人賦予 1 層、魔法敵人賦予 2 層、稀有敵人賦予 5 層，而傳奇敵人賦予 10 層。
seismic_cry: Perform a damaging [Warcry], [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. If an enemy is [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] or a currently [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Slam|Slams] to perform an additional [Aftershock|Aftershock]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

發出一聲傷害性[Warcry|戰吼]，[Knockback|擊退]附近敵人，並對[PrimedStun|可暈眩]的敵人造成[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]。若敵人遭[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]，或[Hit|擊中]正處於[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]的敵人，此技能會[Empowered|強化]後續[Slam|重擊]，使其釋放一次額外的[Aftershock|餘震]。消耗[Charges|耐力球]可略過此技能的冷卻時間。
shard_scavenger: While active, [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze], [Shock], [Ignite], or [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] on an enemy reloads your [Crossbow|Crossbow], restores one cooldown use for your [Grenade|Grenades] and grants a [Buff] causing [Crossbow|Crossbow] [Attack|Attacks] to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.
啟動期間，[Consume|消耗]敵人身上的[Freeze|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]、[Ignite|點燃]或[ArmourBreak|完全破甲]時會裝填你的[Crossbow|十字弓]、為你的[Grenade|擲彈]恢復一次冷卻使用次數，並賦予一個[Buff|增益效果]，使你的[Crossbow|十字弓][Attack|攻擊]在持續時間內不會消耗弩箭。該效果每幾秒只能觸發一次。
shattering_concoction: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Cold] [Attack] damage in an area and inflicting [Exposure]. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].
消耗魔力[Flask|藥劑]的充能，投出一個爆炸瓶，對一片區域造成[Cold|冰冷][Attack|攻擊]傷害，並造成[Exposure|曝曬]。此傷害並不基於你的空手傷害，所以不視為[UnarmedAttack|空手攻擊]。
shattering_palm: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them with an [Attack|Attack] that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals [Attack] damage.
衝向一名敵人，以[Attack|攻擊]對其進行[Strike|打擊]，並釋放一股寒冰震波，將周圍的敵人覆蓋在寒冰碎片中。對這些敵人造成足夠的傷害會粉碎寒冰碎片並觸發爆炸，造成[Attack|攻擊]傷害。
shattering_spite: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your [Presence] to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and [Leech] Life from enemies caught in the blast.
猛擊你的長矛，破壞你[Presence|存在]中的每一名敵人身上的血石之槍以在該敵人周遭造成傷害性的爆炸。每一次爆炸都會根據從敵人身上移除的血石之槍數量而獲得效果，並在達到不同門檻時賦予更多傷害、增加範圍、對受爆炸影響的敵人[Leech|偷取]生命等。
shield_block: Raise your [Shield] to [Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits. Release immediately after [Block|Blocking] when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and [Stun|Stunning] enemies. While your [Shield] is raised you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by hits you [Block], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] you. You cannot [Evasion|Evade] while your [Shield] is raised, but [Evasion] instead grants an equal chance to avoid this [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup.

舉起你的[Shield|盾牌]來[Block|格擋]所有來襲的[Block|可格擋]擊中。當附近有敵人時，在[Block|格擋]後立即釋放以使出一次盾牌重擊，對敵人造成傷害並使其[Stun|暈眩]。當你舉起[Shield|盾牌]且成功[Block|格擋]擊中時，不會因其[LightStun|被輕微暈眩]，但[Block|格擋]過多傷害可能會導致你被[HeavyStunPlayer|沉重暈眩]。當你舉起[Shield|盾牌]時無法[Evasion|閃避]，但[Evasion|閃避]會賦予同等的機率來避免該[HeavyStunPlayer|沉重暈眩]累積。
shield_wall: Ram your [Shield] into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your [Slam|Slams], [Warcry|Warcries], and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.
以[Shield|盾牌]撞擊地面，立起一面土牆。敵人可攻擊牆體，而你施展的[Slam|重擊]、[Warcry|戰吼]和重盾衝鋒會立即將其全部粉碎。牆體在被粉碎時會爆炸，對其正面和周圍敵人造成傷害。
shock_grenade: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that discharges an [Electrocute|Electrocuting] [Lightning] blast when its fuse expires, causing all [Lightning] [Hit|Hits] against enemies to contribute to [Electrocute|Electrocution] buildup for a duration.
發射一顆彈跳[Grenade|擲彈]，在引信燃燒完畢時釋放出會施加[Electrocute|觸電]的[Lightning|閃電]爆發，使得所有對敵人的[Lightning|閃電][Hit|擊中]在一段時間內貢獻至[Electrocute|觸電]累積。
shockburst_rounds_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon [Hit|Hitting] an enemy affected by a [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailment]. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
使用震爆彈藥[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]。其會在 [Hit|擊中] 受到[LightningAilment|閃電異常狀態]影響的敵人時會釋放出傷害脈衝。再次使用此技能以重新裝填彈夾。
shockchain_arrow: Fire a [Lightning]-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailments]. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and [Chain] towards nearby targets, with those [Chain|Chaining] [Hit|Hits] also releasing a shockwave. After the final [Chain], the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. [Consume|Consumes] [Shock] from enemies it [Hit|Hits], but not [Electrocute|Electrocution].

發射一支帶有[Lightning|閃電]能量的箭矢，會自動追蹤受到[LightningAilment|閃電異常狀態]的敵人。擊中這類敵人會使箭矢充能，釋放出造成傷害的衝擊波，並[Chain|連鎖]至附近目標。若這些[Chain|連鎖]的箭矢[Hit|擊中]另一名受到[LightningAilment|閃電異常狀態]的敵人，會重複此過程。在最後[Chain|連鎖]後，箭矢會掉落至地面並形成雷霆之杖。此技能會[Consume|消耗]敵人身上的[Shock|感電]，但不會消耗[Electrocute|觸電]。
shockwave_totem: Raise a [Totem|Totem] that [Slam|Slams] the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts when hit by this [Slam|Slam], damaging enemies standing on it. The [Totem] cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground]. This Skill can be used while [Shapeshift|Shapeshifted].
召出一個[Totem|圖騰][Slam|重擊]附近地面，對附近敵人造成多次傷害。[JaggedGround|碎裂地面]被此[Slam|重擊]擊中時會噴發，對身處其中的敵人造成傷害。[Totem|圖騰]無法製造[JaggedGround|碎裂地面]。此技能可以在[Shapeshift|變形]期間使用。
shred: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first [Attack] can dash to faraway enemies and the final [Attack] [Strike|Strikes] twice. [Attack|Attacking] a [Frozen] enemy will create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments], which are [Projectile|Projectiles] that land and explode after a short delay.
[Shapeshift|變形]成 [Werewolf|狼人型態]並施展一陣狂暴的爪擊。最初的[Attack|攻擊]可以位移至遠處的敵人、而最終的[Attack|攻擊]會[Strike|打擊]兩次。 [Attack|攻擊]任何[Frozen|被冰凍]敵人時會創造[IceFragment|寒冰碎片]，一種會在短暫延遲後落地並爆炸的[Projectile|投射物]。
shroud: Gain Stealth after not using Skills or being Hit for a short time.
在一小段時間未使用技能或受到攻擊後，獲得匿蹤。
siege_ballista: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
召喚一個對空中發射箭矢的[Ballista|砲塔][Totem|圖騰]，箭矢會在落地後不久爆炸。
siege_cascade_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
使用圍城爆發[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]，其會在目標範圍內所有敵人附近掉落一支追蹤弩箭。這些弩箭會停留在地面，並在短暫延遲後爆炸。
sigil_of_life: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Buff] to you and [Allies] standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies [Armour], [Evasion] and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
放置 1 個咒符於地面，給予在範圍內的你和友方強大的[Buff|增益效果]，提供生命回復和增幅[Armour|護甲]、[Evasion|閃避]、和[EnergyShield|能量護盾]。當你站在咒符範圍內時，消耗越多的魔力，增益效果就會變得越強大。
sigil_of_power: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Spell] Damage [Buff] to you and [Allies] while standing in it. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
放置 1 個咒符於地面，給予在範圍內的你和[Allies|友方]強大的[Spell|法術]傷害[Buff|增益效果]。當你站在咒符範圍內時，消耗越多的魔力，[Buff|增益效果]就會變得越強大。
siphon_elements: While active, has a chance to create an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] a target.
啟動時，每當你對目標造成[Freeze|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]或[Ignite|點燃]，有一定機率產生[ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|痕跡]。
siphoning_strike: Dash to a target and [Strike|Strike] them with your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff]. If the target is [Shock|Shocked], [Consume] their [Shock|Shock] to release a [Lightning|Lightning] shockwave around the target and grant you a [Charges|Power Charge]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].
衝向一名目標，以你的[Quarterstaff|細杖]進行[Strike|打擊]。目標帶有[Shock|感電]時，[Consume|消耗]其[Shock|感電]效果向周圍釋放[Lightning|閃電]震波，並賦予你一個[Charges|暴擊球]。這個技能無法受到[AncestralBoost|先祖強化]。
skyfall: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward]. When you have maximum [Glory], you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion]. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion], if possible, to increase the number of [TemporaryMinion|Minions] summoned.

透過消耗[Ward|符文保護]以累積[Glory|榮耀]。當你達到最大[Glory|榮耀]時，你可以從天穹之上呼喚一團質量巨大的維里西姆，在目標位置造成高額傷害並召喚一名[TemporaryMinion|暫時召喚物]。以距離你較近的位置為目標時，則會使你施法時向後跳躍。若允許，則會[Consume|消耗]一個[VerisiumInfusion|維里西姆灌注]以增加召喚的[TemporaryMinion|召喚物]數量。
smash_to_smithereens: Blows strong enough to [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].
足以使敵人[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]的打擊會在敵人周圍範圍內迴響，並大幅[ArmourBreak|破壞護甲]。
snap: [Consume] the elemental energy from a [Frozen], [Shock|Shocked] or [Ignite|Ignited] enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant]. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same [ElementalAilments|Ailment], but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
[Consume|消耗]受[Frozen|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]或[Ignite|點燃]敵人的元素能量，產生一道元素爆發並留下一道[ElementalInfusion|灌注][Remnant|痕跡]。爆發會散播至受到同一[ElementalAilments|異常狀態]影響的其他敵人，但爆發無法進一步散播。也可對寒冰彈施放來產生更大範圍的冰冷爆發。
snipe: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] causes the arrow to explode on impact and [Consume] [Freeze] on directly [Hit|Hitting]. [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze] enhances the explosion.
[Channelling|引導]來為你的弓充能，接著放出一發強力射擊。在[PerfectTiming|完美時機]釋放會使箭矢在撞擊時爆炸，並在直接[Hit|擊中]時[Consume|消耗][Freeze|冰凍]。[Consume|消耗][Freeze|冰凍]會進一步強化爆炸。
snipers_mark: [Mark] a target. The next [Critical|Critical Hit] the target receives [MarkActivate|Activates] the [Mark], [Consume|Consuming] it to deal extra damage and grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge].
對一個目標施加[Mark|印記]。該目標承受的下一次[Critical|暴擊]會[MarkActivate|啟動]該[Mark|印記]，[Consume|消耗]它以造成額外傷害並賦予你一個[Charges|狂怒球]。
solar_orb: Create a fiery [Orb|Orb] that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the [Orb|Orb] are [Ignite|Ignited]. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
創造出一顆週期性地釋放火熱脈衝的火熱[Orb|球體]。非常靠近[Orb|球體]的敵人也會被[Ignite|點燃]。烈焰爆破可鎖定日耀球，以球體做為中心，而非你的位置。
sorcery_ward: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] from [Hit|Hits] for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
被動地幻化出一道防護屏障，在耗盡之前可為你承受來自[Hit|擊中]的[ElementalDamage|元素傷害]。若你停止承受傷害或是完全耗盡了屏障，屏障會在短暫延遲後立即恢復到滿溢狀態。
soul_offering:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful [Spell] damage [Buff] as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your [Minion|Minions]. 
The bone spike is itself a [Minion]. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
用骨刺穿透一具骷髏，在骨刺持續期間賦予你強力的[Spell|法術]傷害[Buff|增益效果]。無法影響你的[Minion|召喚物]。骨刺本身也被視為[Minion|召喚物]。如果它死亡，效果就會立即結束。
soulrend: Fire a [Pierce|Piercing] [Projectile] that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a [Debuff] that [Hinder|Hinders] them and deals [Chaos] damage over time for a short duration.
發射一個會自動尋敵、[Pierce|穿透]的[Projectile|投射物]。被擊中的敵人會受到一個[Debuff|減益效果]，該效果會[Hinder|阻礙]他們並在短時間內造成[Chaos|混沌]持續傷害。
spark: Launch a spray of sparking [Projectile|Projectiles] that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
發射飛散的閃爍[Projectile|投射物]，它們會在地面上不規則移動，直到擊中敵人或消失為止。情況許可時，會[Consume|消耗]一道[Cold|冰冷][ElementalInfusion|灌注]，發射呈環狀分布的許多電球。
spear_of_solaris: Build [Glory] by inflicting [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] on enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your [Spear] in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Modifiers to number of [Projectile|Projectiles] fired do not apply to this skill.

透過對敵人施加[Freeze|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]或[Ignite|點燃]來累積[Glory|榮耀]。當你達到最大[Glory|榮耀]時，可以呼喚阿茲莫里日耀女神，向後跳躍並將你的[Spear|長矛]擲向空中。長矛落地時會在區域內造成巨額傷害，隨後降下神聖天光，週期性脈動並創造出不斷擴散的[IgnitedGround|燃燒地面]。此技能不會受到[Projectile|投射物]數量修正詞綴的影響。
spearfield: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and [Maim|Maiming] them.
刺擊地面，使長矛在自身前方大範圍內從地表刺出。這些長矛會持續一段時間，或在接觸敵人時爆炸，造成傷害並使其[Maim|癱瘓]。
spellslinger_invocation: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you cast [Spell|Spells]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].
啟動時，當你施展[Spell|法術]，便會獲得[Energy|能量]。收集到足夠的[Energy|能量]後使用祈願，將會消耗[Energy|能量]以觸發插槽中的[Spell|法術]，若有足夠的[Energy|能量]則可以觸發多次。
spiral_volley: Load your [Bow] with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes [Charges|Frenzy Charges] to cause the arrows to deal more damage and [Chain] to other targets. Each target can only be [Hit] once.
為你的[Bow|弓]裝填大量的附魔箭矢，並在你向前方旋轉前進時以環形射出，在可能的情況下會直接朝著目標射擊。消耗[Charges|狂怒球]可使箭矢造成更多傷害，並且[Chain|連鎖]攻擊其他目標。每一目標只能[Hit|擊中]一次。
spirit_vessel_companion: Summons a [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Spirit Vessel [Companion] that uses copies of socketed [Bear], [Werewolf], and [Wyvern] Skills.
召喚一個[Shapeshift|變形]魂靈容器[Companion|盟友]，會使用插槽中[Bear|巨熊]、[Werewolf|狼人]、和[Wyvern|飛龍]技能的複製。
staggering_palm: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, instantly [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunning] enemies which are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun] and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [PrimedStun|Primed] targets in range if your first target was [HeavyStun|Stunned]. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] an enemy with this Skill grants you a [Buff] that causes your [Quarterstaff] [Attack|Attacks] to also fire [Projectile|Projectiles] for a short duration. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] additional enemies adds to the [Buff]'s duration.

衝向一名敵人並對其進行[Strike|打擊]，立即使[PrimedStun|可暈眩]的敵人遭到[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]。如果你的目標被[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]，則額外衝刺並[Strike|打擊]至周遭範圍內[PrimedStun|可暈眩]的敵人。以此技能使敵人[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]會賦予你一個[Buff|增益效果]，使你的[Quarterstaff|細杖][Attack|攻擊]在短時間內也會發射[Projectile|投射物]。對額外敵人造成[HeavyStun|沉重暈眩]會延長[Buff|增益效果]的持續時間。
stampede: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping [Slam] damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of [Attack] speed.
向前衝鋒劃開地面，每一步都會留下一塊[JaggedGround|碎裂地面]。衝鋒結束後，跳起並[Slam|重擊]敵人造成傷害，並使附近所有[JaggedGround|碎裂地面]爆炸，對站在上方的敵人造成傷害。當你開始衝鋒後，此技能的施法速度會受到移動速度而不是[Attack|攻擊]速度影響。
starborn_onslaught: Build up Glory by [Freeze|Freezing] or [Chill|Chilling] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may jump backwards loosing your [Mace] with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases [MoltenFissure|Fissures] and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.
透過[Freeze|冰凍]或[Chill|冰緩]敵人來累積[Glory|榮耀]。當你達到最大[Glory|榮耀]時，你可以向後躍起，將[Mace|錘]像墜落的彗星般全力砸向目標。碰撞會釋放[MoltenFissure|熔岩裂隙]，並導致星辰在該區域短暫落下。
storm_lance: Throw an electrified [Spear] that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with [Lightning] bolts. If the [Spear] is [Detonator|Detonated] by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] on Detonation.
投擲一支帶電的[Spear|長矛]，其會插在地面上並週期性釋放[Lightning|閃電]電流擊中附近的敵人。若此[Spear|長矛]被其他技能[Detonator|引爆]，則會立刻釋放一連串電流並隨即消散。在可能的情況下會消耗一個[Charges|狂怒球]，使其在較短時間內更頻繁地射出電流，並在持續時間結束時自動引爆，於引爆時創造[ShockedGround|感電地面]。
storm_wave: Sweep your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff], projecting a bolt of [Lightning] through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.
以[Quarterstaff|細杖]進行橫掃，在你前方的地面上投射出一道長條裂縫狀的[Lightning|閃電]。
stormblast_bolts_ammo: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a [Detonator] Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
使用雷暴彈藥[Ammunition|裝填你的十字弓]，其會落在目標位置周圍並受到[Detonator|引爆]技能觸發而爆炸。再次使用此技能以重新裝填彈夾。
stormcaller_arrow: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a [Lightning] Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to [Shock]. [Shock|Shocking] any enemy with the Bolt also applies [Shock] to all enemies near the impact.
發射一支箭矢嵌入擊中處，持續短暫時間。時間結束後，[Lightning|閃電]彈會擊中箭矢，將其摧毀並對敵人造成傷害，且有極高的機率使其[Shock|感電]。由此閃電彈對任何敵人造成的[Shock|感電]時，[Shock|感電]會擴散至衝擊點附近的所有敵人。
summon_azmerian_wolf: Summons an ancient [Reviving] Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on [Command]. It [Maim|Maims] when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict [Bleeding], or howl to inspire nearby allies.
召喚一隻遠古的[Reviving|復甦]阿茲莫里巨狼，被[Command|號令]時將會嚎叫並呼喚魂靈開始永恆狩獵。其攻擊時將會[Maim|癱瘓]目標，且可以猛撲撕咬以施加[Bleeding|流血]，或嚎叫並啟發周遭友方。
summon_beast: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Beast] [Companion] to aid you in combat.
召喚一個能在戰鬥中協助你的[Reviving|復甦][MonsterCategory|野獸][Companion|盟友]。
summon_demon_magus: Activate to summon a [Reviving] Demon Magus which casts socketed [Spell|Spells] in order.
啟動以召喚一個[Reviving|復甦]惡魔瑪格思，其依順序施展插槽中的[Spell|法術]。
summon_fire_djinn: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to [Strike] enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating [Fire] [Spell|Spells] when [Command|Commanded] to do so.
召喚魯兹安，一名聽從你的號令的無敵火之巨靈[Minion|召喚物]。魯兹安會在你使用傷害型技能時現身並以巨劍[Strike|打擊]敵人，並且在你對他下[Command|號令]時施放破壞性的[Fire|火焰][Spell|法術]。
summon_infernal_hound: Activate to summon a [Reviving] Infernal Hound which [Ignite|Ignites] enemies near it.
啟動以召喚一頭[Reviving|復甦]獄炎獵犬，[Ignite|點燃]其附近的敵人。
summon_mercenary_companion: Summon a [Reviving] Companion to aid you in combat. The Mercenary will use socketed [Attack|Attacks], and can be given equipment in the Skills Panel.
召喚一名[Reviving|復甦]傭兵協助你進行戰鬥。傭兵會使用鑲嵌的[Attack|攻擊]，並可經由技能選單為傭兵配置裝備。
summon_meta_totem_spell: Consume any combination of 3 [Charges|Power and/or Endurance Charges] to raise a [Totem] that uses socketed [Spell|Spells]. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.
消耗任意的3顆[Charges|暴擊或耐力球]以召喚一根使用插槽[Spell|法術]的 [Totem|圖騰]。無法使用擁有冷卻時間的技能。
summon_mist_raven: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be [Command|Commanded] to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] for each enemy it [CullingStrike|Culls].
召喚一隻神秘、且不可受傷的迷霧渡鴉。被[Command|號令]時將會向目標地點俯衝，在沿途粉碎一面異界之鏡，並對範圍內的敵人造成傷害。渡鴉每[CullingStrike|撲殺]一名敵人即會賦予你一顆[Charges|狂怒球]。
summon_rhoa_mount: Harnesses a [Companion] Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a [Bow] or [Spear]. While mounted you can use [Bow], thrown [Spear], and [Mark] Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being [Hit] will cause [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.
使用[Bow|弓]或[Spear|長矛]時，駕馭一隻可騎乘的恐喙鳥[Companion|盟友]。騎乘時，你可以使用[Bow|弓]、投擲[Spear|長矛]和[Mark|印記]技能，且使用技能時的減速程度降低，但你遭[Hit|擊中]時會累積[HeavyStunPlayer|沉重暈眩]。未騎乘時，恐喙鳥會用其嘴喙來攻擊敵人，但能夠受到傷害。
summon_sand_djinn: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you [Command] him to do so. Kelari delivers swift [Hit|Hits] with massive [Critical|Critical Hit] potential.
召喚克拉里，一名聽從你的號令的無敵沙之巨靈[Minion|召喚物]。克拉里僅會在你對他發出[Command|號令]時行動，做出極易[Critical|暴擊]的迅捷[Hit|擊中]。
summon_skeletal_sniper: Activate to summon long-ranged, [Reviving] Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on [Command].
啟動以召喚遠距離攻擊的[Reviving|復甦]骷髏狙擊手，可經由[Command|號令]命其發射毒氣箭矢。
summon_skeleton_arsonist: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, [Reviving] Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other [Minion|Minions] on [Command].
啟動以召喚投擲炸彈的[Reviving|復甦]骷髏縱火者，可經由[Command|號令]命其引爆其他[Minion|召喚物]。
summon_skeleton_brute: Activate to summon hard-hitting, [Reviving] Skeletal Brutes that can [Stun] [PrimedStun|Primed] enemies and [Warcry] on [Command]. This [Warcry] [Intimidate|Intimidates] nearby enemies and [Consume|Consumes] [Freeze] on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
啟動以召喚力量超群的[Reviving|復甦]骷髏蠻兵，其可以[Stun|暈眩][PrimedStun|可暈眩]的敵人，可經由[Command|號令]施放[Warcry|戰吼]。該[Warcry|戰吼]會[Intimidate|威嚇]附近敵人，並[Consume|消耗]敵人身上的[Freeze|冰凍]來對其周圍區域造成傷害。
summon_skeleton_cleric: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
啟動以召喚[Reviving|復甦]骷髏牧師，其可治療其他召喚物並復甦陣亡的骷髏。
summon_skeleton_frost_mage: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your [Minion|Minions] in an icy shield on [Command].
啟動以召喚[Reviving|復甦]骷髏寒霜法師，其可經由[Command|號令]為你的[Minion|召喚物]施加冰霜護盾。
summon_skeleton_reaver: Activate to summon aggressive, [Reviving] Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on [Command]. Skeletal Reavers do more [Attack] Damage and gain increased [Attack] speed based on their [Rage]
啟動以召喚積極攻擊的[Reviving|復甦]骷髏掠奪者，可經由[Command|號令]將其激怒。骷髏掠奪者會根據他們的[Rage|盛怒]造成更多[Attack|攻擊]傷害並增加[Attack|攻擊]速度。
summon_skeleton_storm_mage: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on [Command].
啟動以召喚[Reviving|復甦]的骷髏風暴法師，可經由[Command|號令]命其對陣亡的骷髏所在處施放閃電風暴。
summon_skeleton_warrior: 啟動以召喚[Reviving|復甦]的骷髏戰士。
summon_spectre: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a [Reviving] [Minion].
召喚被束縛的怪物的靈魂作為[Reviving|復甦]的[Minion|召喚物]。
summon_spiraling_conspiracy: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the [Presence] of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can [Command] some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.
以迷霧渡鴉群環繞自身，對進入領域的敵人造成持續傷害。擊殺敵人、或是位於危險敵人[Presence|存在範圍]內時將會增加群集的數量，但渡鴉群整體會視為單一一個召喚物。你可以[Command|號令]牠們以使一部分鴉群飛出，離開鴉群並攻擊你的目標。
summon_undead_companion: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Undead] [Companion] to aid you in combat.
召喚一個能在戰鬥中協助你的[Reviving|復甦][MonsterCategory|不死][Companion|盟友]。
summon_water_djinn: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn [Minion] to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you [Command] her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your [Allies] with her [Spell|Spells].
召喚納維拉，一名聽從你的號令的無敵水之巨靈[Minion|召喚物]。納維拉僅會在你對她發出[Command|號令]時行動，以[Spell|法術]為你和你的[Allies|友方]降下恢復性的賜福。
supercharged_slam: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to [Slam|Slam] the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by [Aftershock|Aftershocks] dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own [Attack] time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.
透過[Channelling|引導]蓄力施展沉重揮擊，從地面汲取土石使你的錘變大。放開以[Slam|重擊]地面，對撞擊點周圍區域造成傷害，隨後由[Aftershock|餘震]在更大範圍造成傷害。此技能有自己的[Attack|攻擊]時間，不受你武器的攻擊速度影響，且無法被調整。
supporting_fire: Recruit artillery [Minion|Minions] that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your [Command], then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.
招募會在你後方就定位的砲火[Minion|召喚物]。他們會等待你的[Command|號令]，隨後朝目標位置發射無數的箭矢。
tame_beast: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Beast] for a duration, [Hinder|Hindering] them. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Beast] while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the [MonsterCategory|Beast] as a [Reviving] [Companion].
召喚阿茲莫里妖精，在一段時間內吞噬[Rarity|稀有][MonsterCategory|野獸]，並[Hinder|阻礙]牠們。當你在[MonsterCategory|野獸]被妖精吞噬時將其擊敗，牠將會被這顆寶石捕獲，將寶石轉變為允許你將[MonsterCategory|野獸]召喚為[Reviving|復甦][Companion|盟友]。
temper_weapon: [Channelling|Channel] to temper your main hand [Melee] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Attack|Attacks] to Combust when [Hit|Hitting] enemies.
[Channelling|引導]以鍛鍊你的主手[Melee|近戰][MartialWeapon|軍用武器]。每次用錘子敲打鐵砧會[Empowered|強化]後續的[Attack|攻擊]，在[Hit|擊中]敵人時造成戰燃。
tempest_bell: Build [Combo|Combo] by successfully [Strike|Striking] Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum [Combo|Combo], use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be [Hit] by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and [Hit|Hits] which would have caused [Knockback] increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.

以其他技能成功[Strike|打擊]敵人時累積[Combo|連擊]。[Combo|連擊]達到最大值時，使用此技能會讓長杖上的鐘巨大化，接著再將其砸落至地面。鐘落地時會對敵人造成傷害，且可以被你的技能[Hit|擊中]，產生一道會造成傷害的震波。對鐘施加[ElementalAilments|元素異常狀態]後，會使震波造成對應類型的額外傷害，且能造成[Knockback|擊退]的[Hit|擊中]會增加震波的效果範圍。
tempest_flurry: Perform a series of aggressive [Strike|Strikes]. When used in quick succession, the third use [Strike|Strikes] three times, and the fourth use performs a [FinalStrike|Final Strike] that calls down a powerful [Shock|Shocking] bolt.
施展猛烈的[Strike|打擊]。快速連續施展時，第三次[Strike|打擊]為三段攻擊，第四次則會使出一下[FinalStrike|最終打擊]，並召出強勁的[Shock|感電]打擊。
temporal_chains: [Curse] all enemies in an area, [Slow|Slowing] them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
[Curse|詛咒]一個區域內的所有敵人，[Slow|減緩]其速度，並使其帶有的其他效果更慢消退。
temporal_rift: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the [Spell] to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.
啟動時，被動地留下你最近的過往殘影。施放[Spell|法術]時以返回至最舊的殘影處，將你傳送到該位置並使你的生命、魔力和[EnergyShield|能量護盾]重置為當時的值。在使用時移除所有由迷蹤形態延遲、且即將到來的傷害。
the_stars_answer: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly [Trigger|Triggering] Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
憑藉你強大的魔法力量駕馭群星，令維里西姆彗星從天空中墜落至你周圍。較大的彗星定期墜落，在短暫時間內留下[ChilledGround|冰冷地面]。
thrashing_vines: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.
促使巨大的藤蔓生長，隨機出現在目標區域內。藤蔓會在猛砸地面後收回，並在可能的情況下攻擊附近的敵人。
thunderous_leap: Leap into the air and plunge your [Spear] into the ground at the target location, emitting a [Lightning]-charged shockwave.
躍向空中，並把[Spear|長矛]刺入目標地面，釋放一道[Lightning|閃電]衝擊波。
thunderstorm: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become [Shock|Shocked] or [Frozen] more easily. [Plant|Plants] in the area become [Plant|Overgrown].
創造一陣閃電風暴，在範圍內引起雷電劈落和滂沱大雨落下。範圍內的敵人會陷入濕透狀態，使其更容易被[Shock|感電]或[Frozen|冰凍]。 範圍內的[Plant|植物]會變得[Plant|過度生長]。
time_freeze: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.
釋放一道巨大的波動，在持續時間內暫停所有受影響敵人的時間。敵人被暫停時間的次數越多，效果的持續時間越短。
time_of_need: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove [Curse|Curses] and [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] from you.
啟動時，祈求神聖的祝褔，每隔一段治療你並移除你身上的[Curse|詛咒]和[ElementalAilments|元素異常狀態]。
time_snap: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.
操縱時間以重置其他技能的冷卻時間。
tornado: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals [Physical] damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] absorbs that surface's [Debuff], applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.
製造一個在持續時間內吸入敵人並造成[Physical|物理]持續傷害的龍捲風。龍捲風若與友方[ElementalGround|元素地面]重疊則會吸取該地面的[Debuff|減益]，並對龍捲風內的敵人施加該簡益並造成該元素地面種類的對應額外元素傷害。
tornado_shot: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing [Physical] damage over time and [Hinder|Hindering] enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown [Spear|Spears] and [Crossbow] bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied [Projectile|Projectiles]. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.
朝天空發射一支箭矢，在落地處捲起一陣龍捲風，持續造成[Physical|物理]傷害並[Hinder|阻礙]身處其中的敵人。射向龍捲風的箭矢、投出[Spear|長矛]和[Crossbow|十字弓]弩箭會被吸入，使龍捲風朝外射出環狀的複製[Projectile|投射物]。複製[Projectile|投射物]無法再次被複製，即使是其他的龍捲風。
toxic_domain: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be [Poison|Poisoned]. Pustules will [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a duration or when enough [Poison] has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored [Poison] damage and applying [Poison] in an area around it.
在你的周圍產生一片劇毒之花。身處其中會增加你的技能消耗、回復生命，並為你的[Projectile|投射物][Attack|攻擊]附上劇毒膿包，可使其[Poison|中毒]。膿包在一段時間後或是施加一定量的[Poison|中毒]後[DetonationTime|引爆]，依據保存的[Poison|中毒]傷害以造成更多傷害，並在其周圍區域施加[Poison|中毒]。
toxic_grenade: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that causes a burst of [Poison|Poison] gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing [Poison|Poison] cloud. [Burning] effects or [Detonator|Detonator] skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
發射一顆彈跳[Grenade|擲彈]，等到其引信燃燒完畢，會爆發出[Poison|毒性]氣體，對敵人造成傷害並留下不斷擴大的[Poison|毒]霧。毒霧若受到[Burning|燃燒]效果或[Detonator|引爆器]技能影響，便會引發猛烈的爆炸。
toxic_growth: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a delay. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.
朝空中發射劇毒膿包之雨。毒囊在衝擊時造成傷害，接著在一段延遲後[DetonationTime|引爆]。它們可以被施加[Poison|中毒]，使其[DetonationTime|引爆]效果加快和加劇。
trail_of_caltrops: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.
啟動時，在躲避時投出蒺藜。
transmutation_reservation: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.
啟動時，拾起[Remnant|痕跡]會[Trigger|觸發]一陣致命的爆炸，在[Remnant|痕跡]的位置造成基於拾起[Remnant|痕跡]種類的傷害。
triggered_molten_shower: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing [Attack] damage in an area.
對擊中的目標發射熔岩[Projectile|投射物]，會於掉落在周遭時爆炸，在範圍內造成[Attack|攻擊]傷害。
trinity: Become attuned to all [ElementalDamage|Elements] building up Fire, Cold and Lightning [Affinity] based off the highest [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] type dealt by your [Hit|Hits]. Your [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] is enhanced the more [Affinity] of any type you have.
與所有[ElementalDamage|元素]同調，並根據你[Hit|擊中]所造成的最高[ElementalDamage|元素傷害]類型來累積火焰、冰冷和閃電[Affinity|親和]。你任一類型的[Affinity|親和]越高，造成的[ElementalDamage|元素傷害]便會強化。
triskelion_cascade: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast. The [Empowered] [Spell] becomes centred on your location, and [Cascadable|Cascades] to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
借助三曲烈焰的力量以[Empowered|強化]你施放的下一個[Cascadable|可爆發][Spell|法術]。[Empowered|強化]的[Spell|法術]會以你的位置為中心，並以三曲的形狀同時以6個額外區域為目標[Cascadable|爆發]。
twister: Whip up a twister with a flick of your [Spear]. The twister moves forward erratically, [Blind|Blinding] and repeatedly [Hit|Hitting] enemies within.
